scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:check && concurrently --names web,backend,copilot --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow --kill-others-on-fail "WEB_WAIT_FOR_BACKENDS=true pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:copilot"
